headline: Makutano Mining: Nearly One Billion Dollars in Financial Operations Unveiled in Kinshasa
summary: Six institutions presented financing operations totalling $966 million at the Makutano Mining event in Kinshasa on 23 November. More than $400 million had not previously been disclosed.
why: Mining financing in the Democratic Republic of Congo supports copper and cobalt output, which feeds global battery and industrial supply chains.
original_headline: Makutano Mining : près d’un milliard de dollars d’opérations financières dévoilées à Kinshasa
